import json
import os

def main():
    # Read the city configuration
    with open("inputs/wikidata/city_config.json", "r") as f:
        config = json.load(f)
    
    # Extract the Wikidata identifier for the city/region
    # The config might have the ID under various keys
    city_id = None
    if "wikidata_id" in config:
        city_id = config["wikidata_id"]
    elif "id" in config:
        city_id = config["id"]
    elif "qid" in config:
        city_id = config["qid"]
    elif "wikidata" in config:
        city_id = config["wikidata"]
    else:
        # Try to find any key that looks like a Wikidata ID
        for key, value in config.items():
            if isinstance(value, str) and value.startswith("Q"):
                city_id = value
                break
    
    if not city_id:
        raise ValueError(f"Could not find Wikidata ID in config: {config}")
    
    # Generate the SPARQL query for cultural POIs
    # Cultural POIs include museums, monuments, historical sites, etc.
    # We use P31 (instance of) with subclasses of cultural heritage (Q5688)
    # or specific cultural POI types, constrained by P131 (located in)
    
    sparql_query = f"""PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX p: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/>
PREFIX ps: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/statement/>
PREFIX psv: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/statement/value/>
PREFIX psn: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/statement/node/>
PREFIX pq: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/qualifier/>
PREFIX pqv: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/qualifier/value/>
PREFIX pqn: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/qualifier/node/>
PREFIX pr: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/reference/>
PREFIX prv: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/reference/value/>
PREFIX prn: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/reference/node/>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX schema: <http://schema.org/>
PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>
PREFIX foaf: <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/>
PREFIX geo: <http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#>
PREFIX geosparql: <http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#>
PREFIX prov: <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#>
PREFIX ontology: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX base: <http://www.wikidata.org/>
PREFIX bd: <http://www.bigdata.com/rdf#>
PREFIX bif: <http://www.openlinksw.com/schemas/bif#>
PREFIX data: <http://www.wikidata.org/wdata/>
PREFIX mw: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>
PREFIX psn: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/statement/node/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>

SELECT ?item ?itemLabel ?coords
WHERE {{
  ?item wdt:P31/wdt:P279* wd:Q5688;
        wdt:P131/wdt:P131* wd:{city_id};
        wdt:P625 ?coords.
  SERVICE wikibase:label {{ bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en". }}
}}
"""
    
    # Ensure output directory exists
    os.makedirs("outputs", exist_ok=True)
    
    # Write the SPARQL query to the output file
    with open("outputs/t07_query.sparql", "w") as f:
        f.write(sparql_query)
    
    print(f"Generated SPARQL query for city/region {city_id}")
    print(f"Query written to outputs/t07_query.sparql")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
</solution_file>
